title: API keys are easier to manage
summary:
API keys became easier to edit, midijourney moved to GPT-5.2, and Enter got a mobile-friendly tidy-up.

Existing keys can now be renamed, enabled or disabled, and updated with new Pollen budgets, expiry dates, account permissions, and model restrictions without being deleted. Text, Image, and Video permissions also have category-level Select all and Deselect all controls.

The `midijourney` text model now routes to GPT-5.2 while keeping its prompt transform. GPT Image routing was updated, and unused model configurations were removed.

Dashboard sections have clearer visual treatments, pricing tables scroll on narrow screens, and the API-key editor draws model choices from the shared registry. A follow-up corrected import casing for Linux builds and added targeted TypeScript checks.

highlights.title: Edit keys without replacing them
highlights.text: Rename, disable, or update an existing API key's budget, expiry, and permissions. Select or deselect whole Text, Image, or Video model categories when restricting access. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Midijourney now uses GPT-5.2
highlights.text: The `midijourney` text model now routes to GPT-5.2 while keeping its prompt transform. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=midijourney).
